Method of Attack: Bug exploitable through user-installed apps from App Store giving unauthorized access to sensitive data normally protected by a TCC prompt or the platform sandbox
Allows any user-installed app to determine whether any app is installed on the device given its bundle ID
Makes it possible for any qualifying app (e.g., possessing location access authorization) to gain access to Wifi information without the required entitlement
Allows any user-installed app to access analytics logs including medical information, device usage, screen time, application crashes, and other sensitive data
Attack Vector: User-installed apps with location access authorization
Indicators of Compromise: Apple ID email and full name
Complete file system read access to Core Duet, Speed Dial, and Address Book databases
Access to analytics logs including medical and device usage information
